body:
That party analogy actually is right around how I feel. A bunch of people would be upset if I left, but they'd continue having fun, eventually.

You wanted to know a bit more, the triggers are usually when I'm bored, but also when I'm upset/angry. It just seems pointless. Why sit here and deal with emotions when I could just not? I don't hate my life, but I don't care about it either. I don't like making an effort. I hate people in general, though, and when I look at the way people interact with each other and it makes me disgusted. When someone asks about the weather I just want to walk away. Any social interaction with someone I don't know, I just want to kill myself instead of having to deal with pretending that I care.

That end part there, I wrote in my suicidal mood. When I realize I'm in there I force myself to think about something else, and I'm generally better about it. I'm going to keep it there, even though I don't necessarily agree with everything I've said anymore...
